compiled_state.description:
## Context
RP-02 S3 T2 placed the interrupted-retirement repair call in `reconcile.py`'s load phase, at a position that is load-bearing rather than incidental: immediately after the under-lock staleness gate and before the pass's FIRST remote issue fetch. That leaves `reconcile.py` at **799 of the 800-line cap** in `.github/module-size-limit.txt`.

Two RP-03 tickets declare `reconcile.py` in their file impact and will rewire state advancement and exit status through it:

- `diamond-flavoured-esok` (3350-90b1-2651-4c50) — RP-03 S5, "Complete coordinator cutover and remove legacy write fallbacks". Reason recorded: "Make coordinator results authoritative for state advancement and exit status."
- `postmodern-tangled-mollusk` (0f5d-2a24-91d2-4148) — RP-03 S5 T2, "Seal versioned outcomes and proven-state advancement", child of the above. Reason recorded: "Advance state and exit status from proven coordinator outcomes."

Neither can fit in one line, so whichever lands will have to perform a behaviour-preserving extraction on a file at the cap. That is the correct response per AGENTS.md (extract along an existing call-graph seam; never raise the limit) and this ticket does not ask RP-03 to do anything differently. It exists so the extraction preserves one specific ordering invariant that is easy to break silently.

## The invariant that must survive any extraction of reconcile.py
The call `binding_store.repair_at_write_boundary(persist=persist, scoped=bool(scoped_ids))` must remain:
- AFTER the under-lock staleness validation (`ensure_selection_current`), because a pass whose selection is stale has not established that its view is current and has no standing to repair; and
- BEFORE the first remote issue fetch (`fetcher.fetch_snapshot` / `compute_snapshot`).

The pre-observation half is the one with teeth. A durable tombstone is authoritative retirement intent. A pass that fetched first could observe the retired issue answer 200 and then complete that issue's retirement in the same breath as fresh evidence that it is alive; repairing first keeps the recorded decision from racing a later observation. Move the call after the fetch and the repair still runs, still writes correct-looking bytes, and is silently wrong.

## Why this is filed rather than left to review
The failure mode is invisible to almost every test. During RP-02 S3 T2 the mutation that relocates the call to a post-fetch position was seeded deliberately: it is caught by exactly two tests, both in `tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/orchestrate/test_recovery_write_boundary.py`:
- `test_repair_runs_before_the_first_remote_observation` — the behavioural oracle. It drives the real load phase with an event recorder and asserts the repair event precedes the fetch event.
- `test_the_repair_is_invoked_from_reconcile_and_not_from_run_differs` — a structural anchor asserting the call is present in `reconcile.py` and absent from `run_differs.py`.

Both drive or name `_load_snapshots` directly. An extraction that renames or re-splits that phase will force someone to touch them, and the tempting shortcut under time pressure is to relax the assertion rather than re-anchor it. Relaxing it is the thing to avoid.

`run_differs.py` is specifically NOT an alternative home: `reconcile._load_snapshots` performs the first remote fetch inside itself, and both `bind_operation_runtime` and `run_differs()` run after it returns, so no position inside `run_differs.py` can precede remote observation. That is recorded in ADR 0099 alongside the boundary itself.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] After RP-03 S5's change to `reconcile.py`, the repair call still runs after the under-lock staleness gate and before the pass's first remote issue fetch.
- [ ] `test_repair_runs_before_the_first_remote_observation` still fails when the call is moved to a post-fetch position — demonstrated by seeding that move and observing RED, not merely by the suite being green.
- [ ] If the load phase is renamed or re-split, the boundary tests are RE-ANCHORED to the new structure rather than relaxed, and the ordering assertion survives in a form that still discriminates.
- [ ] `reconcile.py` remains within the 800-line cap without raising the limit.
- [ ] ADR 0099's invocation-boundary section is updated if the realized position changes shape.

file_impact.reason: The repair call must stay after the staleness gate and before the first remote fetch through any extraction.
Re-anchor the ordering and structural oracles to the new phase structure without relaxing them.
Update the invocation-boundary section if the realized position changes shape.

compiled_state.title: Preserve the pre-observation repair boundary when reconcile.py is extracted for RP-03 S5
